phrases.latin: ālīsque plaudentēs praecipitēs alia post aliam in aquam dēsiliēbant ibique celerrimē natābant
phrases.english: and, flapping their wings, they dived headfirst into the water one after another and swam very fast there
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 50, 305, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
